messages:
Maya (Marketing): Quick sync 1 launch social plan + webinar follow-ups. Need X/LinkedIn schedule, assets, UTMs, and reply templates by EOD.

Ava (Social): Got it. Proposed: X thread 2pm PT, LinkedIn 11am PT, reminder 24h before, and 1h before webinar. Will stage test posts first.

Priya (Content): I'll make a short X thread + LinkedIn carousel caption + 30s transcript. Need hero image and one benchmark slide.

Sam (Design): Specs confirmed: X image 1200x1200, LinkedIn 1200x627, carousel 1080x1080, hero mp4 16:9 <50MB. CTA color #0057FF.

Jon (Growth): Benchmarks to call out (conservative): ~40% cost reduction, ~85ms median latency @2k tokens. Add footnote "results vary by model/hardware."

Liam (Sales Ops): UTMs: utm_source=social, utm_medium={x|linkedin}, utm_campaign=webinar_aug24. Route demo requests to HubSpot queue "Inbound - Social" and tag benchmark clicks as "benchmark_interest."

Ava (Social): Quick reply templates draft:
1) Pricing -> "DMing pricing + link: <pricing_url>?utm_campaign=webinar_aug24"
2) SLA -> "Tagging @Liam for enterprise follow-up."
3) Methodology -> "Methodology link in thread, DM for raw data."
4) Demo -> "Book a demo: <demo_link> (Inbound - Social)"
5) RSVP -> "Thanks! Add to calendar: <ics_link>"
6) Feedback -> "Appreciate it 1 can you DM specifics?"

SocialBot (scheduler): Staging posts queued for 2024-07-30T10:00:00-07:00. Will schedule main posts once assets live.

Maya (Marketing): Assignments: Priya final copy + transcript; Sam assets; Ava schedule + replies; Jon UTMs + landing mapping; Liam HubSpot routing. Reconvene 4pm PT for sign-off. :rocket:
